cues.text: Pursuant to the Tenth Schedule, I am required to disclose the following, and I would ask that you not strike me while I do, as it's considered rude.
For the duration of the assessment the Applicant may not employ spellcraft, sorcery, alchemy, venom, curse, blessing, or any conjured effect,
all of which fall under my own jurisdiction and would represent a conflict of interest.
The Administrator is warded against all registered instruments of war as enumerated in Appendix C paragraph 3.
This covers blades, axes, bows, and any implement bearing a recognized certification — sharpness, smiting, and so forth.
Registration confers coverage. The better registered the implement, the more thorough the coverage.
Appendix C does not cover agricultural equipment. Agriculture is administered by the Office of Cultivated Ground.
We have been asking them to update the list since the Bronze Age.
Applicants presenting no implement whatsoever will be recorded as having withdrawn.
The Applicant is billed for the assessment at the standard rate. Payment is taken from the estate where applicable.
Upon approval the office is vacated and the Administrator's standing lapses. Successor arrangements are governed by Appendix Q.
In the event of approval, the award is bifurcated. The Applicant will be presented two elections and may take one.
I am not permitted to characterize the elections in advance, as that would constitute advice.
I am permitted to tell you that the election is irrevocable, and that every applicant who has ever asked me to reverse it has asked within the hour.
